sections.title: 6v6 Experiment – 2-2-2 Role Queue
sections.description: Revisit the roots of Overwatch with the 6v6 Role Queue experiment, bringing back the structured 2-2-2 team composition for a limited time. This mode combines the thrill of the original six-player team dynamic with the strategic depth of Overwatch 2’s updated heroes and abilities. Dive in to experience a new balance of strategy, adaptability, and pure team synergy—showcasing how modern Overwatch gameplay thrives in a classic format. The 6v6 Experiment will be available to play in the Unranked Menu from December 17 to January 6. This mode uses the Role Queue Ruleset comprised of 2 Tank Heroes, 2 Damage Heroes, and 2 Support Heroes. Map selection and gameplay is based on the Quick Play ruleset.

blocks.title: Experimental Changes
blocks.body: To accommodate the 6v6 format, multiple heroes received balance changes that better suit their abilities in the 6v6 format. These changes are only applied for this mode and are adjusted from the most recent hero balance from the December 10 Patch.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Base health regeneration timer increased from 5 to 7 seconds.

sections.title: Tank
sections.description: Tank role passive Knockback and critical damage reduction removed. No longer affects health. Now only reduces ultimate charge generated by 25%.
